question: Do GSE160332 source labels, sample joins and matrices qualify finite-library CD8 IL-10 descriptions, and which biological-unit claims remain unsupported?
decision: Qualify source identity and numerical measurement eligibility before a separate exposed description; hold population inference if donor/preparation identities are unknown.
strongest_rival: Wrong alias joins, conflating a source biological-replicate statement with verified donors, annotation disagreement or invalid matrix semantics could invalidate a comparison.
discriminator: Cross-check GEO explicit treatment and BioSample/SRA chains; inspect integer nonnegative counts, shared stable-ID annotations, library totals and fixed target coverage, without computing group outcome contrasts.
exposure_record: Final paper outcomes and Figure5 panels have been read; source metadata and headers inspected before freeze. No new matrix group outcome contrasts inspected. This exposed metadata stage does not establish unexposed confirmation.
biological_unit: Human donor/preparation; author reports two biological RNA replicates, but current deposited descriptive unit is a library.
nesting_and_overlap: Eight libraries, two treatment labels each; donor and preparation overlap across arms unknown. Genes nest in libraries; RNA is distinct from ELISA and phospho-flow.
population_and_selection: All deposited count and FPKM rows and eight named library columns. Figure5A/B exact source symbols fixed before source QC; no phenotype-based exclusions.
contrast: No treatment-effect contrasts in metadata stage; verify labels and measurement semantics for later 10-DE-WT, super-10-WT and each active arm-PBS.
endpoint: Sample crosswalk, technical matrix QC, fixed target mapping, library correlation and biological-unit eligibility.
methods: Parse GEO SOFT and XML; match GSM/SAMN/SRX/SRS/SRR and treatment attributes. Require identical stable-ID annotations, unique IDs, finite nonnegative matrices and integer counts. Report full-count library totals and log2(CPM+1) correlation on CPM>=1 in >=2 libraries; no donor inference from correlation. Require unique identical ID sets and exact keyed annotation equality; reorder only FPKM rows to count source order before QC.
missingness_and_exclusions: No dropped libraries or collapsed rows. Absent or ambiguous symbols unavailable, never zero or guessed alias. Record missing donor/preparation/pairing explicitly.
multiplicity: Descriptive QC and mapping only; no p-values, inference or significance-driven filtering.
precision_basis: Source qualification does not estimate population effects; unknown donor independence cannot provide precision.
interpretation_limit: Qualification supports finite-library RNA descriptions only; no verified donor inference, exact author replay, causal STAT activity, secretion, myeloid function or protection.
stop_rule: Stop affected analysis on identity disagreement, invalid matrix values, nonunique stable IDs, annotation disagreement or hash mismatch. Unknown donor keys hold population inference only. Preserve failures; no weakened gates.
amendment_reason: v1 stopped before contrasts because deposited count and FPKM row orders differ. Metadata-only audit found 58735 unique stable IDs in each with identical keyed annotations. v2 explicitly reorders FPKM by exact unique gene_id to count order, requiring complete ID and annotation equality; no values, thresholds or exclusions changed. Failed v1 artifacts retained.
